M13 also shows a wireframe of the generated HTML file, and M14 plain terminal output. Low-fidelity Textual wireframes: fixed character grids at 120×40 and 80×24, grayscale plus one accent named by Textual theme variables. Proposed design, not implemented; example data is fictional except the inventory task prompts; M02, M06, M10 and M13 numbers are computed from one shared set of 12 results. Press Play to follow links; inside a frame use "tab · next focus" and "show widget outlines". Tweaks switch dark/light and the accent.
